scope: 138 independently compared targets; labels are interpretations, neither coder is truth

classification_rules.subset: one set is a proper subset of the other
classification_rules.exclusive: each set contains at least one label absent from the other

selection_rule: Within each cohort, sort IDs lexicographically; select two strict-subset and two exclusive disagreements, preferring source documents not already selected within that cohort; if insufficient, fill in sorted order. No exact cases selected.

selected_cases.source_title: Repealing the ACA without a Replacement — The Risks to American Health Care
selected_cases.reading: Opening mixes contextual history, evaluation and recommendation. Whether the past administration sentence is independently substantial reporting is a paragraph threshold decision.
selected_cases.recommendation: Clarify a minimum independent contribution and use a paired example; existing report/assert boundaries already cover declaratives.

selected_cases.reading: A narrated personal episode also makes a general communication problem concrete; both narrative and illustration are plausible.
selected_cases.recommendation: Keep both; illustrate requires an identifiable idea or relationship made concrete, not merely a story.

selected_cases.source_title: The Other End of the Stethoscope
selected_cases.reading: Brief temporal updates lead into reflection. A sequence of life states can be reporting without necessarily constituting a developed narrative; the closing uncertainty may or may not limit an identifiable claim.
selected_cases.recommendation: Use contrasting report/narrate and qualify examples; require the claim limited, not merely a question.

selected_cases.source_title: Tragedy, Perseverance, and Chance — The Story of CAR-T Therapy
selected_cases.reading: A patient history narrates events and introduces a treatment that gains significance from the following article; orientation is relational to subsequent text, while report reflects content.
selected_cases.recommendation: Keep roles distinct; annotate the later contribution that makes orient operative. Local text alone cannot resolve all relationships.

selected_cases.source_title: Diabetes Mellitus Increases the Risk of Active Tuberculosis: A Systematic Review of 13 Observational Studies
selected_cases.reading: The final generalization about study quality explicitly goes beyond the individual estimates and includes a counterexample. The established report/interpret boundary applies.
selected_cases.recommendation: Keep both; use inference versus faithful recap as a contrastive example.

selected_cases.source_title: Validation and validity of diagnoses in the General Practice Research Database: a systematic review
selected_cases.reading: A long paragraph combines data quality framing, a case, process description and exceptions. Added report and orient depend on scope and threshold, not missing concepts.
selected_cases.recommendation: Offer a multi-function example with paragraph-level threshold and links to subsequent text.

selected_cases.second_uncertainty: The explanatory relationship is plausible but brief.
selected_cases.source_title: A systematic review of evidence on the links between patient experience and clinical safety and effectiveness
selected_cases.reading: The author values patient experience, lists cases and reasons that fragmented care makes a whole-system perspective useful. Assertion, illustration, explanation and interpretation can coexist depending on contribution threshold.
selected_cases.recommendation: Keep the functions; illustrate coexisting claim and reason, and distinguish inference from mechanism using paired examples.

selected_cases.second_uncertainty: The initial observation also provides context for the recommendation.
selected_cases.source_title: A systematic review of interventions to reduce HIV-related stigma and discrimination from 2002 to 2013: how far have we come?
selected_cases.reading: A recommendation to address stigma and its hypothesized effects coexist; calling the final forecast interpretation or assertion depends on whether synthesis or proposed position is the relevant job.
selected_cases.recommendation: Clarify assert versus interpret operationally with examples rather than merge them.

selected_cases.source_title: Customers as Innovators: A New Way to Create Value
selected_cases.reading: Industry examples accompany an explicit transformation claim and a market figure. Illustration and support can coexist if the figure is linked as a reason, regardless of whether it proves the broad claim.
selected_cases.cause: relational vs intrinsic; role vs evidence validity
selected_cases.recommendation: Retain illustrate and support; code intended evidential link separately from whether evidence justifies the claim.

selected_cases.reading: A measured tolerance is converted into an acceptable time. Whether that conclusion counts as inference beyond faithful restatement is close; illustrative status depends on its relation to surrounding method.
selected_cases.recommendation: Use a near-boundary report/interpret example and record the contextual target of illustration.

selected_cases.reading: The authors describe where they place evaluations in a diagram as part of a method. Whether this is instruction for the reader or narration of the authors’ practice depends on surrounding procedural framing.
selected_cases.recommendation: Clarify instruct as an actionable direction in context, including descriptive first-person method wording; no automatic label.

selected_cases.source_title: The Power of Talk: Who Gets Heard and Why
selected_cases.reading: The paragraph mixes a tentative gender-related proposition, a directions example and a proposed mechanism. An example can illustrate a claim even when its evidential basis is weak; qualification requires a limit attached to a claim.
selected_cases.cause: legitimate multi-function; role vs evidence validity
selected_cases.recommendation: Separate illustration, assertion, explanation and qualification from the strength or truth of the generalization.

second_uncertainty: support: the historical causal claim is asserted rather than independently established in this excerpt
instruct: asking the question is actionable, but the test is not yet explained
support: the excerpt does not establish the broad age-related claim
The checklist describes expected outputs more than the steps for producing each one
explain: the passage states the benefit more than its mechanism
support: the compliment finding is indirect evidence about this specific exchange
instruct: phrased as a description of a team's process but embedded in a stepwise method

limitations: Selection is deterministic but not representative; paragraph readings are not adjudicated truth. Text hashes verify recovered text against recorded provenance, not extraction fidelity or source licensing. No full paragraph text is redistributed.
